explanation: The unit tracks time in the episode: it sits at 9-10 at every step through about trial 80 regardless of rewards, choices or transitions, then falls steadily over the last ~15 trials, reaching 0-2 at D1 by trials 95-99, while GO stays a few points higher than that trial D1 (about 3-7). In those late trials, D2 is fairly high (6-8) when S1 is reached and very low (0-3) when S2 is reached.
